provider_reference_conversion: PromptBuilder validates copied PNG hashes and composites thumbnails onto white for image-conditioned generation; original copied PNGs retain alpha.

color_policy.basis: 游戏美术近似色；不是实测色值、ABV、配方评分或物理混色模拟。
color_policy.glass_lighting: warm highlights and glass reflections do not redefine intrinsic ingredient color

recipe_policy.story: 展示与示例叙事数据，不授权更改原料、杯型、用量、用冰或装饰。
recipe_policy.target_priority: 目标实际配方与成品留杯信息优先；few-shot只示范绘画风格和配方到可见成品的对应关系。
recipe_policy.ice: 制作冰与出品冰分开；过滤后的制作冰不画进成品。
recipe_policy.optional_garnish: 长岛冰茶的冻结示例明确选择1片柠檬片；这不改变原表可选规则，目标DIY可以不选择。
recipe_policy.unknown_dash_conversion: 曼哈顿保留1 dash；无ml换算，不自行补零或估算。
recipe_policy.retained_solids: 莫吉托轻压薄荷叶且不滤去，其他示例无额外留杯制作固体。
recipe_policy.source_quantities_status: 源配方仍保留原有草案/参考状态，few-shot冻结不代表试调定稿。

source_style_template: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual finished cocktail illustration for a 2D western saloon game's parchment recipe journal and menu. Primary request: draw exactly ONE physically plausible {cocktail_name}, with {glass_shape}, {liquid_description}, {ice_description}, and {garnish_description}. Style/medium: refined hand-painted gouache and watercolor game item illustration, semi-realistic proportions, subtle natural paper-like brush texture INSIDE the painted object only, delicate warm dark-brown contour accents, restrained amber highlights, believable transparent glass, clearly readable silhouette. Composition: square canvas, full glass and entire stem/base and garnish visible, centered with generous clean 12 percent margins, slight elevated three-quarter front view that shows the rim ellipse and drink surface. Lighting: soft warm saloon light from upper left, subtle cool glass reflections, preserve the drink's true color. Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha outside the object and through unpainted glass areas; no backdrop, no paper card, no tabletop, no cast floor shadow. Constraints: accurate finished serving presentation, no ingredients placed outside glass, no bottles, no bartending tools, no humans, no hats, no frame, no lettering, no labels, no logo, no watermark; no pixel art, no shiny 3D render, no comic face, no exaggerated fantasy shapes. Output: a crisp square transparent PNG suitable for small in-game catalogue cards.
